brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full present at 0,0,0 level 0, counts piece=1

requirements.requirement: Nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: get_build shows only piece:0,0,0;full + its snap; no neighbours at adjacent q,r or level 1/2; check_build meshClash clear

Configurator offers no drawer sockets on a full hex base (find_sockets drawer=0). Drawers only attach to cut face of half bases (half-n offers 1x s, half-s offers 1x n). Maximum 1 drawer per single base, so 5 is impossible under current placement rules.

finish.summary: Build kept to single full hex base at 0,0,0 with no neighbours above/beside. Five drawers cannot be met: full bases expose no drawer sockets; half bases expose only one each. Verified by find_sockets and check_build mesh clear.
